items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, realistic proportions, no people, no text, no logos. A small British dining room in a Victorian terrace: a round oak pedestal table about one metre across with four simple wooden chairs, a large paper pendant light hanging low over the table, walls painted soft warm white, a slim sideboard against one wall, a round rug under the table, a sash window with daylight. Compact but calm and uncluttered.
